title: 第五十一章 我是龙的传人第五十章 夺少你说夺少
slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 那引路僧脸上笑容有些僵硬。
门口那两个武僧，也齐齐看向江澜。
短暂的沉默过后，引路僧脸上的笑容，终于有点挂不住了。
“香客说笑了。”
“没说笑。”江澜一脸认真道，“我现在，手头确实有点紧，要不这样，你们先让我进去条，回头我让我爹给你们送钱来。”
引路僧眨了眨眼。
“敢问令尊是？”
“始皇帝。”
引路僧：“？”
“怎么了？我是龙的传人，我爹是祖龙，很合理吧？”
引路僧就算是个傻子，这会儿也察觉出不对劲了，面色一变，后退半步道：“你不是香客！”
“恭喜你。”江澜咧嘴一笑，“答对了，但是没有奖励。”
随着江澜这边话音落下，门口两个武僧，同时动了。
左边那个抡起长棍，直奔江澜肩头砸来。
而右边那个，则是压低身子，一棍扫向江澜小腿。
这就是我们热血沸腾的组合技口牙！
但显然，对江澜来说，没什么卵用。
他抬手抓住砸来的长棍，身子微微一侧，避开下方横扫而来的棍影。
随即，他手腕一拧。
那武僧只觉得一股蛮力从棍身传来，虎口当场裂开，长棍脱手飞出。
江澜顺势一脚踹在他胸口。
武僧整个人倒飞出去，重重撞在后院门上，直接昏死过去。
另一个武僧刚要变招，江澜已经欺身上前，抬脚踩住长棍。
“咔嚓！”
一声脆响，长棍当即从中间断开。
那武僧一脸懵逼。
江澜抬手就是一个大逼斗过去。
那武僧躲闪不及，直接原地旋转两圈半，眼神涣散，直愣愣栽倒在地。
见状，那引路僧转头就跑。
看那样子，是可恨爹娘没给他多生两条腿出来。
江澜捡起半截断掉的棍子，随手往前一丢。
那棍子带起一阵破空声，直直插进引路僧后脑。
“噗嗤！”
一时间，红的黄的黑的绿的……
反正就是一股脑地喷洒出来，将地面染出一滩妖冶的黑。
江澜也懒得搜尸了，直接推开院门。
门前是个院子。
门后，是另一个院子。
content_en:
The smile on the guide monk's face was a little stiff.
The two monks at the door also looked at Jiang Lan.
After a short silence, the smile on the guide monk's face finally became a little unbearable.
"The pilgrim was joking."
"I'm not joking." Jiang Lan said with a serious face, "I'm really tight on money right now. Otherwise, you can let me put in the note first, and I'll ask my dad to send you the money later."
The guiding monk blinked.
"May I ask who your father is?"
"The First Emperor."
Guide monk: "?"
"What's wrong? I am the descendant of dragon, and my father is the ancestral dragon. It makes sense, right?"
Even though the guiding monk was a fool, he noticed something was wrong at this moment. His expression changed and he stepped back half a step: "You are not a pilgrim!"
"Congratulations." Jiang Lan grinned, "You got the answer right, but there is no reward."
As Jiang Lan finished speaking, the two monks at the door moved at the same time.
The one on the left picked up a long stick and hit Jiang Lan on the shoulder.
The one on the right lowered his body and swept Jiang Lan's calf with his stick.
This is our passionate combo!
But obviously, it was of no use to Jiang Lan.
He raised his hand to grab the long stick that was thrown at him, and turned his body slightly to avoid the shadow of the stick sweeping from below.
Then, he twisted his wrist.
The monk felt a violent force coming from the stick, the tiger's mouth split open on the spot, and the long stick flew out of his hand.
"Bang!"
Jiang Lan took advantage of the situation and kicked him in the chest.
The monk flew backwards, hit the backyard door hard, and passed out.
Just as the other monk was about to change his moves, Jiang Lan stepped forward and stepped on the long stick.
"Crack!"
There was a crisp sound, and the long stick was immediately severed from the middle.
The monk looked confused.
Jiang Lan raised his hand and faced a big blow.
"Crack!"
The monk couldn't dodge and spun around twice and a half. His eyes were distracted and he fell to the ground in a daze.
Seeing this, the leading monk turned around and ran away.
Looking at it like that, he regretted his parents for not giving him two more legs.
Jiang Lan picked up the half-broken stick and threw it forward.
"Whoosh!"
The stick made a loud sound and penetrated directly into the back of the guide monk's head.
"Pfft!"
For a moment, red, yellow, black, green...
Anyway, it just sprayed out all at once, dyeing the ground a pool of seductive black.
Jiang Lan didn't bother to search for the body and just opened the courtyard door.
In front of the door is a yard.
Behind the door is another courtyard.
